# Restoration — what the bots run

**Recommendation (what the bots run).** Endgame build (level 60), 18/0/33 — respec at level 60. The decision loop walks 88 rules in ascending priority and executes the first whose condition is true. The party fixtures place this spec on level 51 (1 member), level 60 (7 members). [measured on bot runs, private 1.18.1-based realm — `knowledge/classes/druid/restoration/talents.yaml`, `rotation.yaml`]

**Measured in round 155** (amp-6's HPS note; the per-spec table has no row for this spec). **GOOD** healer — 326 HPS over the window, the healers ran 14-17x their round-154 HPS with the resto shaman the exception; direct heals only, so HoT ticks make 326 a floor [measured].

**This page is the bots' half.** It records what our party bots actually run for this spec — the level-60 build and the level-by-level order, the rule firing order the decision loop walks, the kit bands, the round-155 measurement and the recorded deviations. The hand-written guide for this spec is [restoration.md](./restoration.md).

## How the bots play it

On every decision tick the loop walks the rules in ascending `priority`, executes the first one whose condition is true and skips the rest of that tick. The groups below are a reading aid; the priority numbers are the real order. Level is the rule's own `level_min` — the first level it can fire.

### Single target

- **135 — Rejuvenation** (`DS13b-rejuvenation-topup`) — level 4+ · intent `filler` · spell 774
  - **When:** target health at least 70%; target health below 85%; no party member below 70% health; the target does not have Rejuvenation; mana at least 95%; at least 25 mana; (in combat or the resident is not eating or drinking); the resident does not have Aquatic Form; the resident does not have Travel Form.
  - **Why:** HO-TKB-PLAY2-008, the druid half of the band HO-TKB-PLAY2-006 filled for the priest (H09b-renew-topup) and the shaman (SR11b).
  - Sources: [holy-healer.yaml (L557-560)](../../../structured/classes/priest/holy-healer.yaml#L557-L560); [leveling.md § Gameplay by level (L80)](../priest/leveling.md#gameplay-by-level); [measured on bot runs, private 1.18.1-based realm — `knowledge/classes/druid/restoration/rotation.yaml`; supporting: `sql tw_world_spell_template.sql L688`; `doc knowledge/classes/priest/holy/rotation.yaml`; `doc tools/telemetry/analysis/round9-class-census-2026-09-18.md`; +11 more].

  - **When:** not in combat; (own health below 80% or the party is resting and own health below 90%); (no party member below 70% health or own health below 30%); the resident does not have Food; the resident does not have Food; the resident does not have Food; the resident does not have Food; the resident does not have Food; the resident does not have Food; the resident does not have Food; the resident does not have Food; carries usable food.

The spec's own guide page names it (line 168); the item and its aura or enchant id are read from the DB (docs/research/db-queries/tkbplay-205.result.txt).
- **DS00u-nightfin — Use Nightfin Soup:** HO-TKB-PLAY-205 (PIONEER FIX, orchestrator for the owner full-kit order 2026-10-18: buff food, elixirs, oils and stones in use): Nightfin Soup (item 13931, required level 35), buff food (the food's buff aura 18194), out of combat, not moving, not eating or drinking, only when the bags hold it and the buff or enchant is missing (or under 5 min for an enchant), so it is also re-applied after a death or a swap. The spec's own guide page names it (line 171); the item and its aura or enchant id are read from the DB (docs/research/db-queries/tkbplay-205.result.txt).
- **DS00u-tea — Use Nordanaar Herbal Tea:** Restores 525 health and 810 mana (spell 19398, instant) and shares its 120 s category 1172 with the Dark and Demonic Runes; the guide names it as the mana cooldown beside the potions.
- **DS00u-limited-invulnerability — Use Limited Invulnerability Potion:** "Defensive: Limited Invulnerability Potion" (L170): physical immunity (spell 3169, aura 39) for a healer in trouble: under 30 percent health in combat (the page gives no figure: open question 2).
- **DS00q-aquatic-form — Aquatic Form:** HO-TKB-PLAY-140 (owner, 2026-10-08: druids use Aquatic Form for their own swims; the party buff is the shaman's or warlock's (HO-TKB-PLAY-139)): in water and out of combat, Aquatic Form (1066, quest at 16, instant): it breathes underwater and swims faster, so the druid needs no breath buff (p4-group's swim hold counts a druid as covered). self.swimming is the map's liquid at the resident (v28).
- **DS00h-prepull-rejuvenation — Rejuvenation:** HO-TKB-PLAY-025 (vocabulary v8, HO-P1-LOOP-016): Rejuvenation on the tank before a boss pull (`target: tank`): "Before the pull: Rejuvenation, then Regrowth, on the tank" (restoration.md L88). Priority 1: a boss pull outranks a drink in progress.
- **DS07-rebirth — Rebirth:** `mana_pct >= 34` is also corrected, and the unit is why it is not 85: `manaCostPercentage` is a share of BASE mana (Spell::CalculatePowerCost) while `mana_pct` binds to the CURRENT pool (state-vocabulary.yaml), and this workstream's only measured conversion is the priest's - H12-dispel-magic's 18 per cent of base costing exactly 85 mana off a 1190-point bar gives a 2.48 pool-to-base ratio (HO-TKB-PLAY2-001 section 3, which uses the identical 2.48 to infer the druid's own pool at 479 base times 2.48). The previous note declined any reserve at all on a VALUE argument ("what a battle rez is worth against a bar is a judgement the pin does not make - a raised tank is worth more than any number of Regrowths"), which is still true and still a different question from whether the cast can complete; `mana_pct >= 34` answers the second question only.
- **DS00t-tree-of-life-form — Tree of Life Form:** HO-TKB-PLAY-242 (PIONEER FIX, tkb-play endgame specs programme, owner order 2026-10-18): Tree of Life Form for the group aura: "Tree of Life Form gives the Spirit-based healing aura" (guide L61), "keep your HoTs on the tanks and Tree of Life Form for the group aura" (L22). Cost 28 percent of mana (DB), so it is entered only at a pull or in combat (never in the rest hold, where the drink rules would drink it back), with 50 percent mana, no Rebirth target within 30 yd, no Tranquility situation and nobody under 45 percent (Healing Touch and Nature's Swiftness need caster form: DS00u/DS00v leave the form for them).
- **DS00w-leave-tree-between-pulls — cancel form:** HO-TKB-PLAY-242 (orchestrator ruling 2026-10-18): leave Tree of Life Form between pulls, because the form cuts movement speed by 20 percent (DB 45706 Tree of Life Form (Passive), base points -20) and nothing else leaves it. It cannot fight DS00t: entry needs in_combat or party.pull_imminent, leave needs neither (mutually exclusive), plus a 20 s hysteresis since the cast (self.since_cast_ms of 45705, vocabulary v36) so the end of the 10 s pull window and the start of the fight cannot flip the form each tick.
- **DS01-mark-of-the-wild — Mark of the Wild:** HO-TKB-PLAY-025 (vocabulary v8, HO-P1-LOOP-016): `target: party_missing`: the nearest member in range and sight (the resident first, at 0 yd) lacking this buff's aura chain, instead of the lowest-health member; the one-member limit described below is gone. ONE MEMBER PER TICK, NOT THE PARTY (HO-TKB-PLAY2-001, OQ-2811): Tick.cpp picks exactly one healTarget - the lowest-health living member, or the tank while it holds hostiles under Bots.HealTankFirstPct, or the resident under Bots.HealSelfFloorPct - and Party.cpp aims buffs at that same one unit, so `aura_target` here asks about whichever ally is currently lowest on health and never about whoever is missing the buff.
- **DS02-thorns — Thorns:** It carries stances 1 << 30 with SPELL_ATTR_EX2_NOT_NEED_SHAPESHIFT, so it is legal unshifted, which is what this file always is. ONE MEMBER PER TICK, NOT THE PARTY (HO-TKB-PLAY2-001, OQ-2811): Tick.cpp picks exactly one healTarget - the lowest-health living member, or the tank while it holds hostiles under Bots.HealTankFirstPct, or the resident under Bots.HealSelfFloorPct - and Party.cpp aims buffs at that same one unit, so `aura_target` here asks about whichever ally is currently lowest on health and never about whoever is missing the buff.
- **DS02b-thorns-self — Thorns:** HO-TKB-PLAY-190 (PIONEER FIX, orchestrator, amp-5 Q-34 rounds 147-149): not in Aquatic or Travel Form (SPELL_FAILED_NOT_SHAPESHIFT: Jaskel spent 966 of 3,767 resident ticks in Aquatic Form and pushed Thorns 857 times).
- **DS03-innervate — Innervate:** HO-TKB-PLAY-013 (OQ-2568, OQ-2569): out of combat this rule waits while the resident drinks or eats (aura 432, 433 or 435). Once the eat rule stops re-pushing into its own aura, nothing else holds a self-defensive, a form, an aura or a mana cooldown back while seated, and any cast stands the resident up (Bots.DrinkHoldsUnlessHurt 0).
- **DS04-barkskin — Barkskin:** HO-TKB-PLAY-013 (OQ-2568, OQ-2569): out of combat this rule waits while the resident drinks or eats (aura 432, 433 or 435). Once the eat rule stops re-pushing into its own aura, nothing else holds a self-defensive, a form, an aura or a mana cooldown back while seated, and any cast stands the resident up (Bots.DrinkHoldsUnlessHurt 0).
- **DS00u-leave-tree-for-swiftness-heal — cancel form:** HO-TKB-PLAY-242 (PIONEER FIX, tkb-play endgame specs programme, owner order 2026-10-18): Leave Tree of Life Form for the emergency: "You cannot cast Healing Touch in Tree Form" (guide L61) and the emergency is "Nature's Swiftness then max-rank Healing Touch" (L92); DS05 (Nature's Swiftness) now waits for caster form so the swiftness is not spent on a heal the form forbids.
- **DS05-natures-swiftness — Nature's Swiftness:** HO-TKB-PLAY-242 (PIONEER FIX, tkb-play endgame specs programme, owner order 2026-10-18): not in Tree of Life Form (the Healing Touch it exists for cannot be cast there, guide L61); DS00u leaves the form first. HO-TKB-PLAY-190 (PIONEER FIX, orchestrator, amp-5 Q-34 rounds 147-149): not in Aquatic or Travel Form (SPELL_FAILED_NOT_SHAPESHIFT: Jaskel spent 966 of 3,767 resident ticks in Aquatic Form and pushed Thorns 857 times).
- **DS05a-entangling-roots-second — Entangling Roots:** The runtime backs a spell off after two pushes in a row that leave no aura on the target (p1-loop v12, ineffective_backoff for 10 s on that guid), so a creature that shrugs it off costs two casts, not a fight. HO-TKB-PLAY-190 (PIONEER FIX, orchestrator, amp-5 Q-34 rounds 147-149): not in Aquatic or Travel Form (SPELL_FAILED_NOT_SHAPESHIFT: Jaskel spent 966 of 3,767 resident ticks in Aquatic Form and pushed Thorns 857 times).
- **DS06-swiftmend — Swiftmend:** This note used to call that dependency unstatable (a rule cannot choose the heal target, OQ-1804), which was true of CHOOSING but not of READING: on a friendly rule `aura_target(x)` reads the chosen heal target's auras (Loop.cpp FriendlyView), keyed by the first rank of each chain (Tick.cpp), so `aura_target(774) or aura_target(8936)` is true exactly when the ally the cast will land on carries some rank of either HoT. The core refuses the cast otherwise: the pin's Swiftmend script returns SPELL_FAILED_TARGET_AURASTATE unless the target has a druid periodic heal with family flags 0x50 (Rejuvenation or Regrowth), and round nine counted 59 TARGET_AURASTATE on Elowen, the second-largest failure on her stream.
- **DS00v-leave-tree-for-tranquility — cancel form:** HO-TKB-PLAY-242 (PIONEER FIX, tkb-play endgame specs programme, owner order 2026-10-18): Leave Tree of Life Form for Tranquility: "You must leave Tree Form to cast it" (guide L97), "Tranquility (out of Tree Form, 30-minute cooldown)" (L20).
- **DS10-tranquility — Tranquility:** The top-ups stay filler. `doc research/tkb/play/r25-heal-vs-purge.txt` HO-TKB-PLAY-190 (PIONEER FIX, orchestrator, amp-5 Q-34 rounds 147-149): not in Aquatic or Travel Form (SPELL_FAILED_NOT_SHAPESHIFT: Jaskel spent 966 of 3,767 resident ticks in Aquatic Form and pushed Thorns 857 times).
- **DS09m-remove-curse-must — Remove Curse:** HO-TKB-PLAY-186 (PIONEER FIX, orchestrator: owner ruling, meaningful dispels not random; decision 214's principle): the MUST-REMOVE half. amp-5's DB study (harmful player debuffs per dungeon, 2026-10-16: 41 of about 120 removable debuffs are must-remove: control, charm, silence, fear, heal and cast slows, the heavy damage-over-time curses and diseases) names the ids, and this rule removes them by id, high in the ladder so it reacts fast, reading the heal target today (the afflicted member only when it is the heal target; p4-group's view will aim it). The generic cleanse further down the file is now 'when free': below every heal rule and behind a 50 per cent mana floor, so a trivial debuff never costs a heal or the mana for one.
- **DS08m-abolish-poison-must — Abolish Poison:** HO-TKB-PLAY-186 (PIONEER FIX, orchestrator: owner ruling, meaningful dispels not random; decision 214's principle): the MUST-REMOVE half. amp-5's DB study (harmful player debuffs per dungeon, 2026-10-16: 41 of about 120 removable debuffs are must-remove: control, charm, silence, fear, heal and cast slows, the heavy damage-over-time curses and diseases) names the ids, and this rule removes them by id, high in the ladder so it reacts fast, reading the heal target today (the afflicted member only when it is the heal target; p4-group's view will aim it). The generic cleanse further down the file is now 'when free': below every heal rule and behind a 50 per cent mana floor, so a trivial debuff never costs a heal or the mana for one.
- **DS11t-regrowth-tank — Regrowth:** HO-TKB-PLAY-190 (PIONEER FIX, orchestrator, amp-5 Q-34 rounds 147-149): not in Aquatic or Travel Form (SPELL_FAILED_NOT_SHAPESHIFT: Jaskel spent 966 of 3,767 resident ticks in Aquatic Form and pushed Thorns 857 times).
- **DS11-regrowth — Regrowth:** Guarded on its own aura so the over-time half is never wasted, and reading the heal target rather than the party aggregate (rangeIndex 5, positive, so the rule is friendly). HO-TKB-PLAY-013 (OQ-2568): out of combat this rule waits while the resident drinks or eats (aura 432, 433 or 435).
- **DS12-healing-touch — Healing Touch:** Its stancesNot at the pin carries the Tree of Life bit as well as the Moonkin one, which is the sharpest single reason this build does not take Tree of Life Form. The top-ups stay filler. `doc research/tkb/play/r25-heal-vs-purge.txt` HO-TKB-PLAY-190 (PIONEER FIX, orchestrator, amp-5 Q-34 rounds 147-149): not in Aquatic or Travel Form (SPELL_FAILED_NOT_SHAPESHIFT: Jaskel spent 966 of 3,767 resident ticks in Aquatic Form and pushed Thorns 857 times).
- **DS13t-rejuvenation-tank — Rejuvenation:** HO-TKB-PLAY-190 (PIONEER FIX, orchestrator, amp-5 Q-34 rounds 147-149): not in Aquatic or Travel Form (SPELL_FAILED_NOT_SHAPESHIFT: Jaskel spent 966 of 3,767 resident ticks in Aquatic Form and pushed Thorns 857 times).
- **DS13-rejuvenation — Rejuvenation:** HO-TKB-PLAY-013 (OQ-2568): out of combat this rule waits while the resident drinks or eats (aura 432, 433 or 435). With Bots.DrinkHoldsUnlessHurt 0 any cast stands a seated resident up, and in rounds 11-17 buffs, pet upkeep, dispels and non-emergency heals ended drinks and meals out of combat in every mana spec streamed (docs/research/tkb/play/r17-rest-breaks.txt).
- **DS12t-healing-touch-tank-heavy — Healing Touch:** If the tank keeps dropping, your second-highest Healing Touch" (druid/leveling.md L140), and this file stops after the two HoTs: both are `not aura_target`, so once they are up nothing fires on the tank until Healing Touch at under 35 per cent. HO-TKB-PLAY-190 (PIONEER FIX, orchestrator, amp-5 Q-34 rounds 147-149): not in Aquatic or Travel Form (SPELL_FAILED_NOT_SHAPESHIFT: Jaskel spent 966 of 3,767 resident ticks in Aquatic Form and pushed Thorns 857 times).
- **DS13b-rejuvenation-topup — Rejuvenation:** The band and its guards are H09b's, and H09b's reasons carry over because Rejuvenation is the same kind of heal as Renew: a heal over time with an aura on the target. So `not aura_target(774)` is a real repeat guard (the one the shaman's direct-heal top-up lacks, OQ-2517), which is why the ceiling is the priest's 85 and not the shaman's 80.
- **DS08-abolish-poison — Abolish Poison:** HO-TKB-PLAY-013 (OQ-2568): out of combat this rule waits while the resident drinks or eats (aura 432, 433 or 435). With Bots.DrinkHoldsUnlessHurt 0 any cast stands a seated resident up, and in rounds 11-17 buffs, pet upkeep, dispels and non-emergency heals ended drinks and meals out of combat in every mana spec streamed (docs/research/tkb/play/r17-rest-breaks.txt).
- **DS09-cure-poison — Cure Poison:** Quest-taught at 14, one poison at once, and manaCostPercentage 16 like DS08 - about 77 mana at 25, not free. HO-TKB-PLAY-013 (OQ-2568): out of combat this rule waits while the resident drinks or eats (aura 432, 433 or 435).
- **DS09c-remove-curse — Remove Curse:** HO-TKB-PLAY-131 (p4-pioneer decision 189 (d), rotation gaps for tracks 2 and 3 at 26 and 28: no Remove Curse): a curse on the heal target is removed (dispel type 2), the poison rules'' shape; in Shadowfang Keep "not dispelling the Haunted debuff" is the druid healer''s named mistake (druid/leveling.md L318). HO-TKB-PLAY-186 (PIONEER FIX, orchestrator: owner ruling, meaningful dispels): this is now the 'when free' cleanse: it stays below every heal rule and behind a 50 per cent mana floor, so a trivial debuff never costs a heal or the mana for one; the debuffs that matter are removed by the must-remove rule above (amp-5's DB list, decision 214's principle).
